agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Lildozer fainted after two Bulldozes and Ice Shard into Ponyta; it made progress on every turn and enabled the forced priority finish.
Bushtank fainted after three Razor Leafs into Eelektrik, creating a free Ohmnomnom entry while preserving the terminal reserves.
Ohmnomnom used fresh Fake Out plus Spark and Metal Claw before fainting to Mega Drain; Croakatoa then finished Eelektrik without taking damage.
All six switches were forced replacements or direct matchup entries. Every voluntary entrant attacked before any later switch; there were zero reversals, no-action pivots, or switch stalls.
The battle used 23 decisions and 17 attacks, improving on Clone 1 without sacrificing terminal reliability.

correct_choices: Fresh-entry Fake Out was used only once in this branch and executed successfully.
Croakatoa entered only after Ohmnomnom fainted, used priority Vacuum Wave to finish Eelektrik, and remained untouched.
Birdlaw switched into Dustox once, then stayed in for four consecutive Aerial Aces across Dustox and Sunflora.
The authoritative terminal state verified victory with Croakatoa 46 HP, Bugatti 41 HP, and Birdlaw 16 HP.
agent_review.next_test: Run unchanged-bundle Clone 3 from the identical opening; repeat all switch, status, Fake Out, incapacitated-entry, resource, and terminal audits.
